definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.description: Shared installed reasoning contract; gifting meaning is supplied by the module.

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

caseDerivation: All case parameters and keyed input rows use the frozen module.inputs types, units, bounds, keys and references; no missing-value defaults or coercion are inferred.
Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.
Provenance describes accepted factual sources; identifying a source does not authenticate it or infer readiness.
schema.description: Installed closed typed declaration and case-admission validators; this descriptor is not a complete JSON Schema. Publication checks admission, not computed feasibility.

structuralSlots.description: Declare one time origin, common time and money units, and additional numeric units.
Declare required typed parameters and keyed relations.
Declare finite static controls from input-only domains.
Bind the input relation containing explicit joint scenarios.
Bind typed acyclic consequences using the installed expression language.
Declare static activity actors, timing and renewable resource demands.
Map resource capacities and existing bookings.
Name and explain every mandatory commitment obligation.
Bind predicates and shared resource-capacity checks to obligations.
Declare nonrefundable charges and optional timed refundable holds.
Optionally require complete finite lookup coverage.
Supply domain vocabulary without changing calculations.
State accepted premises and the applicability boundary.

caseInputs.description: Supply every declared parameter, including finite choice grids and current limits.
Supply typed records, accepted scenarios, calendars, grants, resources and other declared facts.
Record the accepted source and scope of supplied information.

responsibilities: Complete candidate assignments and all checked scenarios
Activities, interval/resource checks and scoped permission traces
Expense, timed cash events and peak cash where declared
reportResponsibilities.completeReportDocument: Unavailable for this pattern until milestone 5. Public assessment artifacts expose complete calculation data without claiming renderer-ready report support.

app.name: Review a gift-kit commitment — complete arrangements
app.description: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.
app.source:
# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: complete-a-commitment/1
module:
  id: review-gift-kit-flexible-planning
  version: "2.0.0"
  title: Prepare gift kits before commitment
  template:
    id: complete-a-commitment
    version: 1
  question: "Which complete correction package addresses every remaining explanation and can finish before we commit the gift kits?"
  description: "Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work."
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: gifting-operations
        label: Gifting operations
      useCase:
        id: prepare-gift-kit-campaign
        label: Prepare a gift-kit campaign
    gifting:
      profileId: gift-kit-readiness
      profileVersion: "1.0.0"
      packages:
        - id: rehearse-unchanged
          label: "Prepare, rehearse and hand off unchanged kits"
          corrects: []
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: reprint
          label: Replace the printed inserts
          corrects: [replace-insert]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: repair-journey
          label: Correct the destination and checkout
          corrects: [correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: replace-and-repair
          label: Replace inserts and repair the journey
          corrects: [replace-insert, correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: false
        - id: external-replace-and-repair
          label: External replacement and journey repair
          corrects: [replace-insert, correct-destination, fix-checkout]
          requiresConfirmation: true
      checks:
        - id: declared-fault-state
          requirement: COVERAGE
          label: Use an admitted configuration from the published fault catalog
          evidence: A current scoped evidence assessment admitting this fault configuration.
        - id: published-package-effects
          requirement: COVERAGE
          label: Retain the published correction effects of the selected package
          evidence: The author-fixed correction effects from this exact published package version.
        - id: correct-fault-0
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The printed code cannot be read whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The printed code cannot be read, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: correct-fault-1
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The code leads to the wrong destination whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The code leads to the wrong destination, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: correct-fault-2
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Address The intended checkout is restricted whenever it remains possible
          evidence: "A complete package addressing The intended checkout is restricted, or scoped evidence excluding that fault."
        - id: known-owner
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: Assign the complete work to a recorded responsible person
          evidence: A recorded person responsible for this complete correction package.
        - id: scoped-package-permission
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: "Hold recorded authority for this package, person, exact configuration, and whole working interval"
          evidence: "A sourced permission for the selected package and person, matching all six scope fields and covering correction through handoff."
        - id: resource-calendar
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: "Keep the full correction, rehearsal, and handoff within resource availability"
          evidence: An availability interval covering the complete proposed work.
        - id: resource-capacity
          requirement: ACCESS
          label: Keep all proposed work within recorded resource capacity
          evidence: Enough recorded resource capacity throughout the proposed work.
        - id: not-in-past
          requirement: TIME
          label: Start correction at or after the current review time
          evidence: A current proposed start time.
        - id: handoff-by-cutoff
          requirement: TIME
          label: "Finish correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff before the kit commitment cutoff"
          evidence: "Durations and resource availability that fit the cutoff, or a revised commitment."
        - id: package-within-budget
          requirement: COST
          label: Keep the complete proposed package within the recorded spending ceiling
          evidence: "A current package quote within the spending ceiling, or an approved revised ceiling."
        - id: quoted-quantity
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Use a complete-package quote for the current kit quantity
          evidence: A current complete-package quote and duration explicitly covering the stated kit quantity.
        - id: minimum-rehearsal
          requirement: SUFFICIENCY
          label: Allow at least the published minimum duration for the scoped rehearsal
          evidence: "A proposed scoped rehearsal duration meeting the published minimum. This remains a plan, not evidence that rehearsal passed."
        - id: scoped-package-confirmation
          requirement: CONFIRMATION
          label: Confirm the selected arrangement for this exact gift-kit configuration
          evidence: "A sourced positive package confirmation, recorded by a named person, for this exact batch, insert, destination, checkout, device and account, effective at the planned start and valid through handoff."
  units:
    time: minute
    timeOrigin: Start of this gift-kit preparation review
    money: USD cent
    count: unit of resource capacity
    quantity: gift kit
  assumptions: ["The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.", One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration., Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge., "The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.", "The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.", "Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.", An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.]
  inputs:

      insertRevision:

      people:

          name:
            type: string
          role:
            type: string
      permissions:
        key: [id]
        columns:

            type: string
          insertRevision:
            type: string
          destinationRevision:
            type: string
          checkoutRevision:
            type: string
          deviceScope:
            type: string
          accountScope:
            type: string
          id:
            type: string
          packageId:
            type: string
          actorId:
            type: string
          validFrom:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          validThrough:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          source:
            type: string
      resources:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          capacity:
            type: integer
            unit: count
            minimum: 0
      calendars:
        key: [resource, start, end]
        columns:
          resource:
            type: string
          start:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          end:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
      bookings:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          resource:
            type: string
          start:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          end:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          amount:
            type: integer
            unit: count
            minimum: 1
      confirmations:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          packageId:
            type: string
          batchId:
            type: string
          insertRevision:
            type: string
          destinationRevision:
            type: string
          checkoutRevision:
            type: string
          deviceScope:
            type: string
          accountScope:
            type: string
          confirmed:
            type: boolean
          validFrom:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          validThrough:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          recordedAt:
            type: integer
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          source:
            type: string
          recordedBy:
            type: string
  choices:
    - id: packageId
      domain:
        values: [rehearse-unchanged, reprint, repair-journey, replace-and-repair, external-replace-and-repair]
    - id: startMinute
      domain:
        parameter: startOptions
  scenarioDomain:
    table: scenarios
  derived: []
  activities:
    - id: correct
      actor:
        ref: parameter.actorId
      start:
        ref: choice.startMinute
      duration:
        op: lookup
        table: packages
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.packageId
        column: repairMinutes
      resources:
        - resource:
            literal: production-team
          amount:
            literal: 1
    - id: rehearse
      actor:
        ref: parameter.actorId
      start:
        ref: activity.correct.end
      duration:
        ref: parameter.rehearsalMinutes
      resources:
        - resource:
            literal: production-team
          amount:
            literal: 1
    - id: handoff
      actor:
        ref: parameter.actorId
      start:
        ref: activity.rehearse.end
      duration:
        ref: parameter.handoffMinutes
      resources:
        - resource:
            literal: production-team
          amount:
            literal: 1
  resources:
    definitions:
      table: resources
      idColumn: id
      capacityColumn: capacity
    bookings:
      table: bookings
      resourceColumn: resource
      startColumn: start
      endColumn: end
      amountColumn: amount
  requirements:
    - id: SUFFICIENCY
      label: Complete correction
      meaning: The selected complete package addresses each fault in every remaining explanation.
      waivable: false
    - id: COVERAGE
      label: Remaining explanations
      meaning: Every scenario comes from the author-declared fault catalog and the engine checks the whole admitted relation.
      waivable: false
    - id: ACCESS
      label: "People, resources, and permissions"
      meaning: "The proposed work has a known owner, resource capacity and availability, and recorded exact-scope permission."
      waivable: false
    - id: TIME
      label: Commitment cutoff
      meaning: The complete prospective work fits between now and the kit commitment cutoff.
      waivable: false
    - id: COST
      label: Spending ceiling
      meaning: The complete package cost fits the recorded spending ceiling.
      waivable: false
    - id: CONFIRMATION
      label: Confirm the selected arrangement for this exact gift-kit configuration
      meaning: "For any author-designated package, retain a named, sourced positive confirmation matching its package and all six configuration fields, recorded by the current review time, effective when correction starts, and valid through handoff."
      waivable: false
  constraints:
    - id: declared-fault-state
      requirement: COVERAGE
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: or

          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq

                  - literal: none
              - op: eq

                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: false
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: print
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: false
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.id
                  - literal: destination
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault0
                  - literal: false
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault1
                  - literal: true
              - op: eq
                args:
                  - ref: scenario.fault2
                  - literal: false
          - op: and

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

module.title: Prepare gift kits before commitment
module.question: Which complete correction package addresses every remaining explanation and can finish before we commit the gift kits?
module.description: Compare one authored correction package across every remaining fault configuration, including simultaneous faults. Prospective correction is distinct from completed work.

packages.label: Prepare, rehearse and hand off unchanged kits
Replace inserts and repair the journey

checks.evidence: A current scoped evidence assessment admitting this fault configuration.

checks.label: Retain the published correction effects of the selected package
checks.evidence: The author-fixed correction effects from this exact published package version.

checks.evidence: A complete package addressing The printed code cannot be read, or scoped evidence excluding that fault.

checks.evidence: A complete package addressing The code leads to the wrong destination, or scoped evidence excluding that fault.

checks.evidence: A complete package addressing The intended checkout is restricted, or scoped evidence excluding that fault.

checks.evidence: A recorded person responsible for this complete correction package.

checks.evidence: A sourced permission for the selected package and person, matching all six scope fields and covering correction through handoff.

checks.evidence: An availability interval covering the complete proposed work.

Finish correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff before the kit commitment cutoff

checks.evidence: A current package quote within the spending ceiling, or an approved revised ceiling.

checks.label: Use a complete-package quote for the current kit quantity
checks.evidence: A current complete-package quote and duration explicitly covering the stated kit quantity.

checks.label: Allow at least the published minimum duration for the scoped rehearsal
checks.evidence: A proposed scoped rehearsal duration meeting the published minimum. This remains a plan, not evidence that rehearsal passed.

checks.label: Confirm the selected arrangement for this exact gift-kit configuration
checks.evidence: A sourced positive package confirmation, recorded by a named person, for this exact batch, insert, destination, checkout, device and account, effective at the planned start and valid through handoff.

units.timeOrigin: Start of this gift-kit preparation review

assumptions: The module author declares the complete fault catalog and the deterministic prospective correction effects of each package. These are reviewed modeling premises, not evidence that correction finished.
One static complete package must work across all admitted configurations. This model does not synthesize sequential investigations or choose a different package for each possible fault configuration.
Quoted repair cost is the complete prospective package charge in this bounded profile. Rehearsal and handoff have recorded durations and no separate monetary charge.
The supplied permission registry is complete. An empty registry supplies no permission; evaluating a plan grants no authority.
The same recorded person and production resource perform correction, scoped rehearsal, and handoff in that order. Resource intervals are half-open; permission valid-through includes the endpoint.

Quantity scopes this review but does not scale time or expense automatically. Each complete-package quote must explicitly match the stated kit quantity; changing quantity requires a matching quote and duration.
An unchanged-kit package may have a positive preparation duration and no correction effects or monetary charge. Its preparation is not a repair or evidence of a successful rehearsal.

requirements.label: Complete correction
requirements.meaning: The selected complete package addresses each fault in every remaining explanation.

requirements.label: Remaining explanations
requirements.meaning: Every scenario comes from the author-declared fault catalog and the engine checks the whole admitted relation.

requirements.label: People, resources, and permissions
requirements.meaning: The proposed work has a known owner, resource capacity and availability, and recorded exact-scope permission.

requirements.label: Commitment cutoff
requirements.meaning: The complete prospective work fits between now and the kit commitment cutoff.

requirements.label: Spending ceiling
requirements.meaning: The complete package cost fits the recorded spending ceiling.

requirements.label: Confirm the selected arrangement for this exact gift-kit configuration
requirements.meaning: For any author-designated package, retain a named, sourced positive confirmation matching its package and all six configuration fields, recorded by the current review time, effective when correction starts, and valid through handoff.
